messages:
leo_marketing: Final rehearsal today 2pm PT — quick sync on run-of-show, mic checks, demo fallbacks. Please confirm availability and any outstanding needs. :loudspeaker:
anya: I can join. I'll bring the demo laptop at 1:30 so we can test video + audio. Do we have a backup model endpoint for the demo (Private env) in case the primary hits rate limits?
ryan_pm: Yes — backup is `private-demo-v1-qa` in us-west-2. If latency goes >450ms we failover to `hosted-small` (note: slightly lower perf). I'll post routing policy after this thread.
jess_ops: Recording set — @channel recording will start at 1:55pm PT. I need confirmation that all speakers have mics and headsets. Also will we run the audience poll?
sangeeta_prod: Speakers confirmed: @maria-speaker, @devin-engineering, @noah-research. Maria wants 5 minutes more in the Q&A. We should reserve 8 mins for Q&A to be safe.
deploybot: sched: rehearsal-room allocated -> zoom.redwood.com/marketing-rehearsal-2pm (passcode in calendar).
audience-bot: reg: 278 registered, est-attend 190 (based on historical 68% show rate). Consider bumping poll window at minutes 10 and 30.
leo_marketing: Run-of-show (compact):
```
1:55pm - Recording on, final mic checks
2:00pm - Intro (leo) - 3m
2:03pm - Product/bench narrative (sangeeta) - 8m
2:11pm - Live demo (devin) - 12m
2:23pm - Deep dive: cost/latency tradeoffs (noah) - 8m
2:31pm - Panel QA (maria + panel) - 12m
2:43pm - Closing & CTA (leo) - 2m
2:45pm - Optional extended chat / followups
```
anya: Demo fallback checklist for devin: please ensure you have:
- local recording of demo steps (video) on laptop
- creds for `private-demo-v1-qa` (shared via 1Password)
- `hosted-small` API key as env var (HOSTED_KEY)
If you want I'll shadow-control the laptop when we start.
ryan_pm: Routing policy doc (short):
- primary: private-demo-v1-1 (pinned)
- if 95th latency >450ms OR error rate >2% -> route to private-demo-v1-qa for 60s
- if private-demo unavailable -> hosted-small (no pin)
- ops alert on failover to #eng-oncall
jess_ops: Mic check plan:
- Speakers join 1:40pm in rehearsal room
- Sound check sequence: maria, devin, noah (quick 30s test each)
- Test screen share and video for devin's demo at 1:50pm
- I will post green/red status in the room chat: `:white_check_mark:` / `:no_entry_sign:`
leo_marketing: Audience engagement:
- Live poll at minute 5 (one question: "Which is your biggest infra concern?")
- AMA dropbox for questions during the session (sam will moderate)
- Post-webinar CTA: link to benchmark report + sandbox invite (landing: redwood.com/benchmarks-demo)
sangeeta_prod: Note for speakers: limit live token usage in demo — prefer prefix caching examples. If demo runs long, switch to pre-recorded clip at 2:14pm (we'll cue that).
anya: Confirming I'll shadow-control the demo. Also I uploaded the pre-recorded clip to the rehearsal drive: https://drive.redwood/rehearsals/demo-clip.mp4
leo_marketing: Quick checklist before we close this thread — please react with :thumbsup: when done with your item:
- Speakers confirmed (sangeeta)
- Demo laptop + pre-recorded clip ready (anya)
- Routing policy & keys verified (ryan_pm)
- Recording & streaming checks (jess_ops)
- Polls created & moderation assigned (leo_marketing)

sangeeta_prod: ✅
anya: ✅ (will be in room 1:30)
ryan_pm: ✅ keys verified
jess_ops: ✅ recording set, stream test at 1:55
deploybot: reminder: rehearsal starts in 1h (automated).
leo_marketing: Thanks all — see you at 1:30 for pre-checks. We'll keep this thread for any last-minute notes. :raised_hands:
